serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I have a bad feeling…
I feel like leaving her alone was a bad decision, but I don’t think my words would reach her right now anyway.
Hopefully she thinks things through and all will return to normal.
Oh! Maybe I should ask {f_botName} for some advice?
Melissa-{{wi}} I mean, Amei, told me to keep a secret so that option will have to wait for now.
To be honest, I still can’t fathom all the things I heard today… 
I knew that Amei had a troubled past, but this…{{wi}} is beyond anything I could’ve imagined.
Huh? What’s that?
As I was about to enter the landlord's building, my phone started shaking.
It’s a message from Amei…
“I feel so stupid. I actually thought that I had found my savior, but I was wrong. There’s no saving me. I’m leaving the city together with the real Melissa. I made some arrangements beforehand in case you failed to save me.” 
“Don’t look for us. Unfortunately I can't blackmail you and force you to kill Melissa because of my programming, but I can still report you if you disregard my other commands.”
“We knew each other for a short time, I really enjoyed it, but at the same time I can’t stand it. Something like me shouldn’t be allowed to be happy.”
“I feel bad for Annalie and {f_botName} so I set up a chatbot based on my personality. It should fool them into thinking that I migrated to another country looking for a better job. Well, it’s not far away from the truth, I guess. Soon they will forget about me and all of your lives will go back to normal, like I never existed.”
“Don’t blame yourself for this. There’s nothing you could’ve done to prevent me from leaving, one way or another.”
“Goodbye forever, Amei” 
You: Are you kidding me…
